title: Story premise ENT045: The Block City Night Wave
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: Bedtime is crossing town one window at a time. Takeaway/theme: A sequence can carry a signal while preserving one needed exception.
description: A caretaker wants to dim a toy city at bedtime, but the control is on a roof across the map. A prearranged sequence of mechanical shutters closes one window and exposes a reflector to the next, carrying a visible dimming wave across the city while leaving a moonlit path home.
